# Kildare Clinic

> GP walk-in medical centre on Claregate Street in Kildare, Ireland.

Source: https://www.kildaredoc.ie/

## Contact and location

- Address: Claregate Street, Kildare, R51 P635, Ireland.
- Telephone: [085 867 8192](tel:+353858678192).
- Email: [info@kildaredoc.ie](mailto:info@kildaredoc.ie).
- WhatsApp: [Contact the clinic](https://wa.me/353858678192).
- Website: https://www.kildaredoc.ie/.

## Services listed on the website

### General Practice

Everyday GP consultations for illness, injury and ongoing health concerns, with no appointment required.

### Family Healthcare

Care for every stage of life, from children's check-ups to health reviews for parents and grandparents.

### Travel Advice

Health guidance before you travel abroad, including advice on recommended vaccines, malaria prevention and precautions for your destination.

### Disease Management

Ongoing monitoring and support for diabetes, blood pressure, asthma and other long-term conditions, with regular reviews to keep your health on track.

## Plan a visit

Walk in or call ahead. Register at the front desk, see the doctor and discuss the next steps for your care. Monday–Saturday: 10:00 AM – 2:00 PM & 5:00 PM – 8:00 PM. Sunday: closed for now. Contact the clinic to confirm current opening hours, waiting times and service availability before travelling.

## Location question

The clinic is on Claregate Street, Kildare, R51 P635 — look for the black and gold signage.

# Medical certificates at Kildare Clinic

Source: https://www.kildaredoc.ie/medical-certificate

Kildare Clinic offers medical certificates requested online and reviewed by Irish-registered GPs. Certificates are issued within 5 hours and only where clinically appropriate.

## Certificates and prices

- Sick Certificate: €30. An official note from a GP confirming you're unwell and unfit for work or study, for short-term minor illness.
- Unfit for Travel Certificate: €40. A GP certificate stating you are medically unfit to travel, commonly needed for airline, hotel or travel insurance claims.
- Fit to Travel Certificate: €40. A GP certificate confirming you are medically fit to travel, for airlines, tour operators or insurers that ask for one.
- Return-to-Work / Fit for Work Certificate: €30. A GP certificate confirming you have recovered and are fit to return to work or study.

## How it works

1. Send your request: Choose your certificate and fill in a short form with your details and what you need it for.
2. Pay and speak to the doctor: We email you a secure payment link, and one of our GPs calls you to verify your request.
3. Receive your certificate: Once approved, your certificate is issued and sent to you securely by email.

## Not included

- Backdated (retrospective) certificates
- Certificates that need a physical examination
- Long-term illness or detailed medical reports

## Questions

**How quickly will I receive my medical certificate?** Certificates are issued within 5 hours once the doctor has verified your request. You'll first receive a payment link by email, and a GP will call you to verify your details.

**How much does a medical certificate cost?** Sick and Return-to-Work certificates cost €30. Unfit for Travel and Fit to Travel certificates cost €40.

**Will I definitely get a certificate?** Certificates are only issued where the doctor considers it clinically appropriate. If a certificate can't be issued, the doctor will explain why and, where needed, advise you to be seen in person.

**Who reviews my request?** Every request is reviewed by an Irish-registered GP at Kildare Clinic, who will call you to verify your request before a certificate is issued.

**Can I get a backdated certificate?** No. We can't issue backdated certificates, or certificates that require a physical examination. For those, please visit the clinic during opening hours.

# Kildare Clinic cookies and browser storage

Source: https://www.kildaredoc.ie/cookies

Google Analytics and Google Maps embeds are optional. Neither loads until its separate category is allowed. Visitors can reject both, accept both or save separate preferences; Cookie settings in the footer reopens the choices. Contact details and website pages remain available when both are rejected.

## Storage

- Kildare Clinic local storage, kildare_cookie_preferences: remembers the saved analytics/maps choices and date. The choice is valid for 180 days; the browser entry remains until cleared, updated or removed by the website.
- Google Analytics cookies, _ga and _ga_*: distinguish visits and measure website use only when analytics is allowed. This website configures an expiry of up to 180 days from cookie creation and disables automatic expiry updates.
- Google Maps embed: may use Google cookies or other browser storage only after maps is allowed. Provider cookie names and durations depend on Google, account and browser settings; no complete fixed inventory is asserted.

Allowing analytics sends usage and browser/device information to Google. Loading maps sends IP address and browser information to Google. Google Fonts requests still load when optional services are rejected. Ordinary external Google Maps/WhatsApp links open those services only when followed.

## Withdrawal

Save a category as off in Cookie settings to withdraw it. Maps are removed. If analytics has started loading, site-accessible Google Analytics cookies are cleared and the page reloads to stop the tag; unsent form entries may be lost. The site cannot clear Google-domain cookies or retract data already sent.

## References

- [Google cookie information](https://policies.google.com/technologies/cookies)
- [Google cookie settings](https://developers.google.com/tag-platform/security/guides/customize-cookies)
- [DPC cookie guidance PDF](https://www.dataprotection.ie/sites/default/files/uploads/2020-04/Guidance%20note%20on%20cookies%20and%20other%20tracking%20technologies.pdf)
